description: Expired grant voucher. Same shape as vch-001 but the voucher's `exp` is in the past relative to the pinned reference clock. The voucher has no independent lifecycle: it is only ever verified by its issuer during delegation verification, where an expired voucher MUST be rejected at the expiry-monotonicity step (RFC-AITP-0006 §4 step 5: `voucher.exp` MUST be in the future). The signature, typ, and alg checks pass; only the expiry fails.

expected.$comment: There is no voucher-specific expiry code in registries/error-codes.md: a voucher is only ever verified in delegation context, where voucher expiry surfaces as DELEGATION_EXPIRED per RFC-AITP-0006 §4 step 5 ('voucher.exp MUST be in the future ... else DELEGATION_EXPIRED'). This fixture pins that mapping for the standalone verify_grant_voucher conformance op.
expected.rationale: voucher.exp (1711803600) < reference clock (1711900000). Signature/typ/alg are valid; rejection is the §4 step 5 expiry check.
